items.title: New Health Service Commission, Same Old Excuses On Health Care Pay — Specialist
items.summary: The proposed Health Service Commission (SPK) must have powers over health care workers’ pay and allowances, instead of leaving decisions to MOH, MOF, or JPA. Without such authority, SPK risks being toothless and unable to address staff retention. The post New Health Service Commission, Same Old Excuses On Health Care Pay — Specialist appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: IHH CEO Reveals Uncomfortable Truths Of Malaysian Health Care
items.summary: IHH Healthcare Malaysia CEO Kamal Amzan's new book, "The Future We Choose", has substance and delivers on its promise to reveal "uncomfortable" truths. But it's a little preachy about public health care, without similar moralising to the private sector. The post IHH CEO Reveals Uncomfortable Truths Of Malaysian Health Care appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Senator: What’s The Use Of ‘Toothless’ Health Service Commission?
items.summary: Senator Lingeshwaran asks what's the point of a "toothless" Health Service Commission (SPK) without the power to create new positions or set wages for health workers. He backs amendments to the Federal Constitution to authorise such powers for SPK. The post Senator: What’s The Use Of ‘Toothless’ Health Service Commission? appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: DAP MP Wants More Powers For Proposed Health Service Commission
items.summary: Bandar Kuching MP Kelvin Yii calls for constitutional amendments to empower a proposed Health Service Commission (SPK) to create positions and set emoluments for health workers. Such powers would be unique for SPK, compared to other service commissions. The post DAP MP Wants More Powers For Proposed Health Service Commission appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Lindung 24/7 Backlash Tests Support For Mandatory Social Insurance: Socso
items.summary: Lindung 24/7 was widely opposed because Malaysians resist sharing unforeseen risks, says Socso's deputy CEO Edmund Cheong. He believes long-term care insurance may be more acceptable because ageing is inevitable, but contributions must remain mandatory. The post Lindung 24/7 Backlash Tests Support For Mandatory Social Insurance: Socso appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: A Mini-Stroke Is An Emergency, Not A Reprieve — Dr Andrew Choong
items.summary: The mini-stroke offers a valuable opportunity: a warning that arrives before lasting harm, with a window of days in which established treatment can lower the risk of what may follow. The post A Mini-Stroke Is An Emergency, Not A Reprieve — Dr Andrew Choong appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Dzulkefly ‘Commits’ To Forming Health Service Commission Without Power To Create Positions Or Set Emoluments
items.summary: Dr Dzul commits to forming a Health Service Commission (SPK), but says it won't be able to create positions, devise a retirement scheme, or set emoluments. SPK will only have appointment or disciplinary powers under Article 144 of the Federal Constitution. The post Dzulkefly ‘Commits’ To Forming Health Service Commission Without Power To Create Positions Or Set Emoluments appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Penang Hits Ambulance Response Target With Community Responders
items.summary: State exco Daniel Gooi says Penang is the only state that has achieved the national ambulance response target, due to community responders. About 58% of its Priority 1 emergency calls this year were responded to within 15 minutes, surpassing the 50% KPI. The post Penang Hits Ambulance Response Target With Community Responders appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: UMMC Expands Free Dengue Vaccination And Health Screening For Children In Klang Valley
items.summary: UMMC's Program Saringan Anemia dan Pencegahan Denggi brings free screening and vaccination services closer to families across the Klang Valley. The post UMMC Expands Free Dengue Vaccination And Health Screening For Children In Klang Valley appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Obituary: Dr Sng Kim Chai, Sole Community Doctor Of Pulau Ketam — Dr Sng Kim Hock
items.summary: Dr Sng Kim Chai, who served humbly as Pulau Ketam's sole community doctor for four decades, lived a simple meagre life. He supported a family of five children and was very considerate in his fees to the village folk.
